# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 14 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 14

**14:1** And Joseph feared greatly and left her and pondered what he should do with her. And Joseph said, "If I conceal her sin, I will be found fighting against the law of the Lord. If I reveal her to the children of Israel, I fear lest what is in her is from an angel, and I will be found delivering up innocent blood to the judgment of death. What then shall I do with her? I will put her away from me secretly."

**14:2** And the night came upon him, and behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Do not fear because of this child, for that which is in her is from the Holy Spirit. She shall bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."

**14:3** And Joseph arose from sleep and glorified the God of Israel who had given this grace to him, and he kept her safe.
